mapper.insert: insert into tbl_schedule (trip_day_id, member_id, place_id, schedule_title, schedule_start_time, schedule_memo, schedule_ai_source) values (#{tripDayId}, #{memberId}, #{placeId}, #{scheduleTitle}, #{scheduleStartTime}, #{scheduleMemo}, #{scheduleAiSource})
mapper.select: select id, trip_day_id, member_id, place_id, schedule_title, schedule_start_time, schedule_memo, schedule_ai_source, created_datetime, updated_datetime from tbl_schedule where id = #{id}

select id, trip_day_id, member_id, place_id, schedule_title, schedule_start_time, schedule_memo, schedule_ai_source, created_datetime, updated_datetime from tbl_schedule where trip_day_id = #{tripDayId} order by schedule_start_time
mapper.update: update tbl_schedule set place_id = #{placeId}, schedule_title = #{scheduleTitle}, schedule_start_time = #{scheduleStartTime}, schedule_memo = #{scheduleMemo}, updated_datetime = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.delete: delete from tbl_schedule where trip_day_id in (select id from tbl_trip_day where trip_id = #{tripId})
